card.fires_on: Words in economic or trade discussions where the next word is likely 'competitive', 'competitiveness' or 'compete', such as competitiveness itself, 'compete in', jobs going overseas, or goods priced out of markets.

modes.label: Competition words themselves
modes.description: The marked word is a form of compete or competitiveness in a passage on economic impact.

modes.label: Words leading into competition
modes.description: A small word or trade term that sets up competition with other firms or countries.
modes.example: will allow the United States to compete<< in>> the clean energy future

modes.label: Offshoring and price pressure
modes.description: Words about jobs moving abroad or goods undercutting markets.
modes.example: as domestic manufacturing jobs go<< overseas>> and businesses take a tougher approach
